description: Application under Section 73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 to carry out development without compliance with Condition 1 (Approved drawings) for Application Reference Number: 25/00400/HOU (Part demolition of an existing ground floor of building, erection of single storey rear and first floor side extension.) dated 30/04/2025. Variation to increase the depth of patio area from the originally consented 1.0m to 3.6m.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates shall be carried out in accordance with the materials specified on the approved plans and on the submitted application form unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and Policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The flat roof area(s) of the development to which this permission relates shall not be used as a roof garden, balcony, seating area or other similar amenity area, and shall not be accessed except for the purpose of maintenance or in the case of emergency.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of the original planning permission ref :25/00400/HOU dated  30 April 2025.Reason: This is required by Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Prior to any above-ground works of the development to which this permission relates, a Fire Safety Strategy shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The Fire Safety Strategy shall demonstrate how the development will achieve the highest standards of fire safety and shall include the following details:1) suitably positioned outside space for fire appliances/ an evacuation assembly point; 2) appropriate fire alarm systems; 3) passive and active fire safety measures; 4) appropriate construction details to minimise the risk of fire spread; 5) provision of suitable and convenient means of escape/ an evacuation strategy; 6) provision of suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Fire Safety Strategy and thereafter maintained. The required Fire Safety Strategy shall reference the London Plan Guidance for Fire Safety (February 2022) where applicable. A Reasonable Exception Statement shall be submitted where the Applicant considers parts of or all of Policy D12(A) of the London Plan 2021 to not be relevant. Reason: In the interests of fire safety and to ensure the safety of all building users, in accordance with Policy D12 of the London Plan 2021.

Notwithstanding the details as shown on proposed east elevation of the proposed rear terrace patio extension as shown on drawing number PL11,  within 3 months of the date of this permission details of the revised elevation drawing showing an increase in height of 0.2m  added to the 2no  proposed 1.8m high close boarded boundary fence panels between and  closest to nos 6 and 8 Beechcroft Avenue to provide an overall height of 2.0m of the panels as measured from the terrace floor level, must be submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing.Reason: To ensure satisfactory living conditions for neighbouring occupiers, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
